title: saxifraga stellaris subsp. prolifera
intro: Saxifraga stellaris subsp. prolifera, commonly known as the Alpine Saxifrage, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the saxifrage family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and improve immune function, due to its therapeutic actions such as antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents of Saxifraga stellaris subsp. prolifera include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties. However, more research is needed to fully understand the effects of Saxifraga stellaris subsp. prolifera on human health.
